issues.on_page: Mullen Hospital District in Hooker County, General Fund tax request 65,000 (p2); receipts are property tax, state tax credits and pro-rate only
issues.issue: The extractor treats the whole filing as business-type because the entity is a hospital district. But this is a cash-basis budget form for a tax-levying district: about 92% of receipts are property tax and state tax credits, no patient revenue is shown, and everything sits in a General Fund. That looks like a governmental taxing district that supports a facility, not the hospital enterprise itself. All lines and the balances (business_type vs top-level beginning/ending_cash) would move if it is governmental. A person should decide.
